launchManifest.validation: Closed exact fields/values, direct duplicate rejection, <=64KiB; validate CodeManifest first then compare exact byte digest. All policy strings are requirements for a future executor, not evidence any OS property is enforced. No launch executor or runtime registration is provided. requirements: Retained OS peer lifetimes on both sides

completeConsent.amendment: Remove gestureProof. Broker owns both affirmative displayed-scope confirmation and actual OS callback; calling complete alone grants nothing. No operational flow is implemented.

wire.closed: All nested DTO objects reject extra/duplicate keys. Invalid UTF-8, lone surrogates, floats for integer fields, nonfinite/unsafe integers, wrong variants and oversized input refuse. No Unicode normalization. Direct typed decode, no permissive map intermediary.

bounds.identifierCharacters: Pinned CPython Unicode16 printable and non-whitespace; all-scalar compatibility hash in crate data metadata
bounds.labels: Nonblank trusted literal plain text with no controls; no model/history/markup interpretation. Trusted label provenance remains a future private adapter obligation.
bounds.epochMilliseconds: Unsigned integer <=9007199254740991; trusted wall and monotonic deadlines additionally enforced

wire.responseValidation: Decode by outstanding request. Decoder checks static shape/bounds; future trusted client/adapter must additionally enforce actual origin, current-time/monotonic lifetime and original connection. No ticket authenticity follows from decoding hex.

lifecycle.states: pending -> confirming -> consumed -> uncertain-before-future-host-effect; pending/confirming may cancel/expire; invalidated attachments cannot issue tickets
lifecycle.prompt: One begin per challenge; duplicate confirming returns Busy without creating or joining another prompt
lifecycle.callback: Private move-only association. No Clone, Default, Deserialize, external verifier trait or positive public constructor. Unit-only constructors remain cfg(test). Privacy protects safe external callers, not malicious TCB code.
lifecycle.grantIntent: Internal move-only intent, not a ticket. Reserve before future external effect; no retry or reset after failure. Existing Host.approve/bind remain unchanged and have no production adapter from this core.
lifecycle.cancellation: Invalidate before ACK. Unknown/consumed/expired cannot return successful rollback. ACK does not prove UI dismissal, binding revocation or physical effects stopped.
lifecycle.retention: No eviction/reset/reauthorization operation. Conservative refusal of any second challenge for same attachment, including terminal state. Capacity exhaustion refuses. Persistent restart/attachment retirement is unimplemented; production always unavailable. Downstream bind uncertainty must remain with its durable owner.
lifecycle.uncertainty: Lost complete/bind ACK never permits automatic retry, new challenge/ticket, rebind/transfer or journal clearing. No recovery lookup added.
lifecycle.binding: Original immutable scope/options/policy/generation and actual native canonical connection. No reset/compression/route/profile redirect. Ticket must eventually be issued and consumed on exactly the original actual transport, never caller transportId.

challengeDigest.algorithm: SHA256(UTF8('stellar.native-consent.v2\0' with trailing NUL byte) || ASCII(semanticProposalSha256) || raw32(policyIdentity) || u64be(attachmentGeneration) || UTF8(canonicalPrepared))
challengeDigest.canonicalPrepared: Baseline sorted object keys recursively, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, no normalization; typed validated DTO only
challengeDigest.syntheticVector: broker_tests::digest_matches_pinned_python_canonical_utf8_vector; SHA256 dece1129da4399247ea32f19476124e0f86fbda48b704f032d2f0554d6242b86; no OS verification, consent or receipt

threatBoundary.limits: IPC identity and Windows OS verification are not transaction signing, gateway code attestation or proof of physical human input. Current mutable shared gateway is unqualified.
threatBoundary.activationGate: Separate explicit acceptance of this limited boundary or reviewed stronger isolation, plus qualified launch/custody/verifier/host/consumer paths and separate application authorization
